test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: While playing a game, P is standing to the south of D, who is to the west of A, who is to the north of J. If P exchanges his position with A, then what is the direction of J with respect to P?
solution:
Given →

P is standing to the south of D, who is to the west of A, who is to the north of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27853f04b1fdb016f5dcaf7852df70d7d022d995c012f30b4097d8526614e3fb.png] 

After exchanging position of P with A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b95191b8896cae038adabe60e68166830a955f1aa2a4cd8e0355df08df743562.png] 

**South is the direction of J with respect to P.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"South".**
